title: Marco Rubio's SSCI staff seek whistleblowers
summary: UAPGerb tells of Marco Rubio's SSCI staff seek whistleblowers, about 2017-present at Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Marco Rubio who you know UFO heads who are deep in the subject have known he's had an interest in the subject since 2017 and has employed his staff at the SSCI and others to go uh find more about whistleblowers for him.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Marco Rubio, a US senator, has been interested in UFOs since 2017. According to UAPGerb, Rubio has used his staff on the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, the Senate panel that oversees America's spy agencies, and others to learn more about whistleblowers, insiders who say they know about hidden UFO matters. If so, it would mean a senior senator has been quietly digging into the subject for years.
